cases.name: Ann Hoover
cases.narrative:
He broke into her home by boring a tunnel through a common cellar wall. After killing Hoover, he Kirk dragged her back into his side of the house through the small tunnel he dug in the basement and began cutting up the body so he could dispose of it. He was caught in the act. "The opening was just big enough for a person to crawl through, and we believe [Kirk] could well have broken in and dragged a body back through the hole to his building," Freeman said. "He was wrapping her severed parts when we found him, and we believe he was hoping to get them out of the house and dispose of them."

cases.name: Charlee Lurae "Lee" Martin
cases.about:
Her Go Fund Me said, "Charlee was kind, loving, hardworking, and deeply devoted to her family. She had a gentle heart and a giving spirit, always showing up for the people she loved. She was not just a daughter and sister. She was a light, a protector, and a source of encouragement to those around her.

Charlee was also a musician. Music was part of who she was, and she shared that love with her younger sister, Mikhail. She spent her time encouraging Mikhail’s creativity and growth, often using her weekends to pour into her. Charlee placed Mikhail’s first piccolo in her hands, helping spark a passion that continues today.

Charlee lived with her brother Aaron, who has struggled with serious mental health challenges. During a recent period of instability after being off his medication, a tragic and unexpected incident occurred that resulted in the loss of Charlee’s life. This devastating event has left our entire family in shock and heartbreak."
